acceptance_criteria.criterion: Translation missing a required numbered placeholder shows alert-danger block and blocks confirmation
Translation with extra numbered placeholder not in source shows alert-danger block
Translation with all required placeholders but different specifiers (e.g. %1$02d for %1$s) passes with no warning
Source string with no numbered placeholders triggers no check regardless of translation
After correcting a rejected translation, the warning disappears and confirmation succeeds

summary: Added PlaceholderValidator sub-object to Editor with getNumbers(text) (extracts sorted unique argument indices via /%([0-9]+)\$/g regex) and equal(a, b) (deep array comparison).

Updated Confirm() to read data-native-text from the row element, extract source numbered indices, and block save with alert-danger .placeholder-warning div if sets differ. Clears stale warning when sets match. No override mechanism: translators must correct before saving.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent.
